media.codec: H.264 baseline, no B frames, single video track
media.codec_private: AVCDecoderConfigurationRecord, one SPS and one PPS, four-byte NAL lengths
media.ingestion: uint32 big-endian JSON metadata size (1..65536), version=1, frames=[{timestamp_ms,keyframe,size}], then concatenated AVCC access units; 1..1000 frames per fragment
media.capture: Annex-B with AUD delimiters, fixed configured FPS, caller-supplied absolute capture start milliseconds; operator owns encoder/camera and clock accuracy
media.fragment: IDR first, strictly increasing integer epoch milliseconds, <=10 seconds span, <=8 MiB configured bytes, one known-size MKV Cluster
media.session: one unknown-size MKV Segment, one track header, multiple Clusters, ABSOLUTE timestamps; chunked HTTP request and simultaneous newline-delimited JSON ACK response

durability.admission: SQLite synchronous FULL atomic media+monotonic high-water commit before queued receipt
durability.full: RejectNewData API; CLI blocks reading source at one bounded fragment until capacity is released
durability.retirement: only contiguous PERSISTED prefix of fragments sent in this session; later ACK across gap does not release media; BUFFERING, RECEIVED, EOF and HTTP 200 never retire media
durability.replay: at least once; restart/reconnect resends byte-identical unacknowledged fragments with original absolute timestamps; ambiguous persistence may duplicate remote media
durability.source_retry: exact pending fragment or most recent admitted fragment is idempotent; conflicting/older/overlapping input fails; no unbounded historical dedupe table
durability.rejection: 4000,4003,5000,5001 retry; other ERROR ACKs durably pause spool for operator inspection; never skip rejected media
durability.expiry: SF-057 container credentials fetched afresh before each session; expired or <=10 seconds remaining rejected; active session ends five seconds before expiration
durability.binding: state directory bound to version/stream/region/codec/dimensions/emulator/control endpoint and credential broker UID; incompatible reuse refused

limits.spool_bytes: configured 2 KiB..1 GiB charged media+256 per fragment; max fragment must fit
limits.session: 1..300 seconds, <=1000 fragments per reconnect, >=200 ms between fragments and <=12 MB/s pacing
limits.responses: 16 KiB discovery/credential body, 4096-byte ACK line, <=8 ACKs per offered fragment +100
limits.disk: SQLite main file plus rollback journal (up to roughly twice live media during writes) and bounded page/schema overhead; FULL auto-vacuum reclaims deleted media
limits.memory: one ingress fragment and one upload fragment plus bounded ACK and list of at most 1000 session timestamps

references.name: EdgeConnectorForKVS 1.0.5 (functional scope only; no binary/source incorporated)
KVS PIC v1.3.0 ACK wire declarations (Apache-2.0 reference only)
KVS C producer v1.5.0 signing semantics (Apache-2.0 reference only)
references.semantics: streaming signature uses SHA256(empty), not UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD

boundary: Independently authored native functional subset. No proprietary EdgeConnectorForKVS source, Greengrass configuration or producer SDK code incorporated. Not AWS connector drop-in compatibility, RTSP discovery, audio, transcoding, exactly-once delivery or live AWS certification. Reference roadmap fixtures are separate from component execution.

credentials.server_identity: required credential_provider_uid; wait up to five seconds for a nonzero peer socket inode (accepted socket), then match kernel TCP owner UID before Authorization; UID0/inode0 is not root identity; missing/ambiguous/wrong identity fails closed
credentials.caller_identity: SF-057 authenticates component UID and foreground task token; distinct component UID remains required
credentials.provisioning: operator pins broker UID explicitly; no automatic detection or static-key/default-chain fallback
